title: DilChat AI Assist — machine-readable requirements catalog (V1)
description: Documentation-only mirror of DILCHAT_AI_ASSIST_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA.md. No implementation. Founder direction DEC-048.

components.name: moon_receptivity_context_v1
components.primary_input: current sidereal Moon vs natal chart (deterministic)

components.name: conversation_evidence_model_v1
components.primary_input: shared conversations, explicit + inferred preferences, feedback

components.name: ai_assist_guidance_fusion_v1
components.role: compose signals into user-reviewable guidance; LLM wording last
components.primary_input: the three components + explicit preferences + safety/privacy

requirements.text: AI never sends a message; manual send required.
Overlay opens only on explicit tap; never auto-opens.
Exactly one recommendation; text never duplicated.
User-controlled insert and rephrase actions.
Engine records signal origin of each suggestion.
Categories: Good/Gently/Space/Avoid; sensitive shown only when supported.
Guna and Moon not collapsed into one weighted average.
Composition follows the defined hierarchy.
Structural-prior weight begins at 60% for eligible cold start.
Structural-prior weight never below 30%.
Weight declines only from qualified evidence.
Conversation evidence can override the static prior.
Explicit over inferred; recent repeated over static prior.
Recommendation precedence order enforced.
Moon is a bounded temporary modifier applied separately.
Moon cannot independently create an avoid topic.
Moon context expires and is recalculated.
Moon language estimates receptivity, never emotion/diagnosis/guarantee.
Internal Guna logic proprietary and hidden.
No user-visible Guna/Koota/Dosha/source/weights.
No compatibility score shown.
No classical-authority validation claim.
Structural prior sets posture only, never a verdict.
Private content cannot enter shared recs without consent.
One partner's private AI chat never advises the other.
Deleted/revoked/unshared/other-couple data never used.
Unpairing revokes relationship-derived recommendation access.
Users can disable sources, correct/remove/delete learned data.
Users understand broad evidence category; internals stay hidden.
Safety overrides every personalization signal.
Explicit boundaries override every astrological signal.
No deterministic mental-state claims / diagnosis / guarantees.
Avoid only via boundary/negative-evidence/conflict/safety.
Explicit-tap open; context retained; AI ASSIST heading.
Exactly one recommendation shown.
Recommendation text not duplicated.
Good Topics one item per line; no two-column topic table.
AI suggestions distinct from partner messages (visual + a11y).
Empty avoid state shows required copy.
Accessible touch targets + screen-reader labels; mobile-first cards.
Chat header avoids call and video-call icons.
Every recommendation exposes provenance categories internally.
Record versions, signals, confidence, weight, reason, timestamps, action.
Do not persist unnecessary chain-of-thought / private reasoning.
Prove 60% cold-start weight.
Prove 30% floor.
Prove weight declines only from qualified evidence.
Prove explicit boundaries override astrological signals.
Prove Moon cannot create an avoid topic alone.
Prove evidence can override the static prior.
Prove private cannot enter shared recs without consent.
Prove AI never sends.
Prove single, non-duplicated recommendation.
Prove no compatibility score shown.
Prove unpairing revokes recommendation access.
Prove Moon context expires and recalculates.
Prove user corrections modify future inferred preferences.
Prove no deterministic mental-state claims generated.

acceptance_criteria.text: Guna weight begins at 60% for an eligible cold-start profile
Weight declines only from qualified evidence
Explicit boundaries override every astrological signal
Moon context cannot independently create an avoid topic
Conversation evidence can override the static prior
Private content cannot cross into shared recommendations without consent
Only one recommendation appears in the overlay
Good Topics are displayed one item per line
Temporary Moon context expires and is recalculated
User corrections modify future inferred preferences
No deterministic mental-state claims are generated

open_questions.text: Exact mathematical decay curve from 60% to 30%.
Minimum number and quality of evidence events before weight reduction.
User controls for disabling each personalization source.
Whether users see broad provenance labels.
Whether 'Avoid Topics' remains in V1 or is renamed 'Approach Carefully'.
